scenarios.boundary: Existing no-schema compile/evaluate and sequence enumeration
scenarios.metrics: Warm throughput, latency distribution, allocated bytes/op and GC counts
scenarios.proposedWorkload: Ordinary untyped scalar/axis/map/array queries; first-item and full enumeration separately.
scenarios.requiredInputs: Pin current shipped and candidate capabilities and consumer fixtures; isolate compile/cold/warm execution.

scenarios.boundary: Compiled schema environment and authority lookup
scenarios.metrics: Compile time, lookups/op, CPU, allocated bytes, cache size and invalidation cost
scenarios.proposedWorkload: Schema compile/reuse and supported/foreign authority lookup over owner-selected schemas.
scenarios.requiredInputs: Owner selects actual schema/component sizes and supported/refused profile; compile and lookup budgets separate.

scenarios.metrics: Per-item allocation/boxing, throughput, duplicate value conversion and retained metadata
scenarios.proposedWorkload: Start with measured one/eight-child native decimal subset; separately add actual list/union/nil/no-value and preserve/strip/foreign controls.
scenarios.requiredInputs: Decimal subset is real; broader routes need actual supported native carriers and owner qualification before measurement.

latency.statistic: Maximum of three per-session medians over five measured cycles each

allocation.statistic: Maximum of three session-average allocations on the measuring thread

draftBudgets.classification: Provisional diagnostic guardrail; not owner SLA, statistical tolerance or regression acceptance

allocation.statistic: Maximum of three session-average allocations on the measuring thread

draftBudgets.classification: Provisional diagnostic guardrail; not owner SLA, statistical tolerance or regression acceptance

scenarios.metrics: Time to first item, throughput, read counts/bytes, allocations and peak retained memory
scenarios.proposedWorkload: Persistent readers over two immutable store versions; same logical query, cold/warm and first/full results.
scenarios.requiredInputs: Owner supplies original-format store snapshots, expected order/namespaces and read-count/byte observations.

scenarios.metrics: Lease retention/release events, retained graph/resources and cancellation-to-release timing
scenarios.proposedWorkload: Partial consumption, early break, close, cancellation, nested/reentrant access and work/cleanup faults on actual snapshot leases.
scenarios.requiredInputs: Record exact deterministic ownership/release events; forced-GC observations cannot replace the release contract.

scenarios.metrics: Total latency and phase times: acquisition, assessment, compile, execution, projection/serialization, IPC
scenarios.proposedWorkload: Actual XSLT worker preview over ordinary, supported assessed and persistent routes; distinct/shared roots and source-free invocation.
scenarios.requiredInputs: Select typed/persistent worker routing explicitly; byte transport is not live authority. Pin acquisition through IPC/output phase boundaries.

scenarios.metrics: Hash/serialization bytes and time, cache hit/miss behavior, retained memory
scenarios.proposedWorkload: Repeated unchanged run followed by changed schema/profile/source/store snapshot, with timeout/kill/reopen controls.
scenarios.requiredInputs: Pin worker configuration, run identity and publication currentness checks; no route is approved by a matching digest alone.

scenarios.metrics: Scaling curve, peak memory, timeout/cancellation response and cleanup observations
scenarios.proposedWorkload: Owner-selected size/depth/width ladder and bounded refusal, cancellation/close/reentry schedules.
scenarios.requiredInputs: Keep current operational input/frame/deadline limits separate from measured latency, allocation and retained-resource budgets.

scenarios.boundary: API shape alternatives before final signatures
scenarios.metrics: Dispatch/IPC counts, allocation, conversion cost and useful work per call
scenarios.proposedWorkload: Measure callback/dispatch/conversion counts and immutable metadata reuse on selected real workloads.
scenarios.requiredInputs: Do not propose a new batch/capability/scope API until the actual owner route demonstrates the need.

guardrailRationale: Review starting point only: two times largest observed session statistic, rounded upward to 25 ms or 64 KiB. Headroom is a discretionary proposal, not a measured variance bound or product requirement.

operationalLimits.scope: Historical product controls from the owner reply, not accepted candidate PF budgets; no bounds on whole-engine/native memory or between-checkpoint time inferred.
